entities.name: EPS mobile identity
entities.description: Information element that provides either the IMSI, GUTI, or IMEI identity. It is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and maximum length of 13 octets.

entities.name: IMSI
entities.description: International Mobile Subscriber Identity, coded using BCD coding. If number of identity digits is even, bits 5-8 of last octet are filled with end mark '1111'.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity, with bits 5-8 of octet 3 coded as '1111', contains MCC, MNC, MME Group ID, MME Code, and M-TMSI fields.

entities.name: IMEI
entities.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity, coded using BCD coding. Format described in 3GPP TS 23.003.

entities.name: Type of identity
entities.description: Field in octet 3 bits 1-3 that indicates the identity type: IMSI (001), GUTI (110), or IMEI (011). All other values reserved.

entities.name: Odd/even indication
entities.description: Field in octet 3 bit 4 that indicates whether there are odd (1) or even (0) number of identity digits. For GUTI, this is set to 0.

entities.name: Identity digits
entities.description: Variable-length field containing the actual identity digits, starting from octet 4. Coding depends on identity type (BCD for IMSI/IMEI, specific structure for GUTI).

entities.name: MCC
entities.description: Mobile Country Code, located in octet 4 and octet 5 bits 1-4 for GUTI. Coded as per ITU-T Recommendation E.212.

entities.name: MNC
entities.description: Mobile Network Code, located in octet 5 bits 5-8 and octet 6 for GUTI. Uses BCD coding and consists of 2 or 3 digits. If only 2 digits, bits 5-8 of octet 5 are '1111'.

entities.name: Odd number of identity digits
entities.description: Condition where the number of identity digits is odd, indicated by odd/even indication bit set to 1.

entities.name: Even number of identity digits
entities.description: Condition where the number of identity digits is even, indicated by odd/even indication bit set to 0. Also used for GUTI.

relations.description: EPS mobile identity IE contains the type of identity field that specifies whether it carries IMSI, GUTI, or IMEI.
EPS mobile identity IE contains the odd/even indication field that specifies the parity of identity digits.
EPS mobile identity IE contains the identity digits field that carries the actual identity data.
Type of identity field value '001' indicates the IE contains IMSI.
Type of identity field value '110' indicates the IE contains GUTI.
Type of identity field value '011' indicates the IE contains IMEI.
GUTI identity contains the MCC field for mobile country code.
GUTI identity contains the MNC field for mobile network code.
For IMSI with even number of identity digits, bits 5-8 of last octet are filled with end mark '1111'.
GUTI always uses even number of identity digits condition (odd/even indication bit set to 0).
